label: Fitness Centers & Gyms
heroHeading: Add recovery technology that keeps members coming back
seoDescription: Member retention recovery zones for gyms & fitness clubs. Commercial IceVault, sauna and red light systems that drive recurring revenue.

valueProps.title: Member retention
valueProps.body: Recovery amenities are the fastest-growing driver of gym loyalty. Give members a reason to stay, and to pay more, with commercial-grade contrast therapy and red light.

valueProps.title: Plug-and-play setup
valueProps.body: Purpose-built for high-traffic fitness floors. Equipment integrates into existing layouts with minimal construction, plumbing or electrical work.

valueProps.title: Built for heavy use
valueProps.body: Self-cleaning cycles, reinforced builds and smart diagnostics keep maintenance costs low.

valueProps.title: Launch support
valueProps.body: From floor-plan consultation to modality training, staff enablement and marketing materials, we help you launch a recovery zone members use and value.

features.title: Turn your gym into a recovery destination
features.body: Members today expect more than weights and cardio. OneBase saunas, IceVaults and red light beds let you offer the premium recovery experience boutique studios charge a fortune for, right on your gym floor.

features.title: A new revenue stream with built-in demand
features.body: Offer recovery as a premium add-on or tiered membership upgrade. Facilities using OneBase report higher average revenue per member and reduced churn within the first 90 days of launch.
